primary_coaching_focus.topic: Missing button-up handshake on a fragile booking
primary_coaching_focus.quote: Alright, Jay. We'll look forward to seeing you on Saturday. Hope you have a good Thanksgiving.
primary_coaching_focus.why: This appointment is already fragile — it's five days out, the customer has cycled through three unavailable days, the bill is only promised not captured, and the rep still skips the hour-block, no-driving/computer instruction, and 'is that fair?' handshake at close. On a booking this loosely held, the full button-up matters more, not less.

key_moments.quote: Well, I just had a new roof put on, I mean, just last year.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is a classic roof_or_home objection that could be inverted ('a new roof is actually the best time to add solar — it's already structurally sound') but the rep answers literally instead ('it wouldn't damage it at all'), missing a reframe opportunity.

key_moments.quote: How long is the warranty? Because my roof has a lifetime warranty.
key_moments.stewart_read: Rep's answer ('between the two, you should be getting... twenty five years... but say there was an issue with installation or something like that, you'd be able to cover that') is muddled and doesn't clearly resolve whether the roof's lifetime warranty is voided by panel installation — a real, specific customer question left unanswered rather than dodged cleanly or admitted honestly.

key_moments.quote: I I just don't wanna send you guys on a wild goose chase because, you know, I I think it's gonna be very limited in what we can do.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is a guilt-framed soft objection (customer protecting the rep's time, not a hard no) per the guilt_as_objection_detection directive. The rep's response acknowledges but doesn't explicitly reframe the appointment as customer-in-control ('you're not wasting anyone's time, this costs you nothing to find out').

key_moments.quote: Yeah. I mean, we meet with people all day every day, so it's no issues if it doesn't make sense for you.
key_moments.stewart_read: Rep de-escalates the guilt-driven objection with low pressure, keeping the customer engaged enough to agree to send the bill next.
